title: RoboCerebra: A Large-scale Benchmark for Long-horizon Robotic Manipulation Evaluation

layout.note: A full-width pipeline strip (a) on top; below it a wide panel (b) with a filmstrip over four cards, and a narrow panel (c) with a bar chart at the right; panels are split by dashed grey rules.

lesson: For a benchmark, stack three tiles: a short construction pipeline with loop-back arrows for quality checks, a numbered filmstrip of one long task with tinted challenge cards linked to the moments that cause them, and a bar chart that makes the headline multiplier visible with one distinct bar and a red note.
